how_to_apply: Open the ICSI online recruitment portal between 06.11.2026 and 20.11.2026.
Use Windows Explorer (6.x to 11.x) or Google Chrome with JavaScript enabled. The notice says not to use Mozilla Firefox, Netscape Navigator or any other browser.

Fill in every field of the online Resume Form. Do not use special characters such as quotation marks or &. Keep entries short for university name, specialisation, responsibilities, address and school name.
Enter percentages rounded down to the whole number (49.3% or 49.8% becomes 49%). Convert grades into equivalent percentages.
Upload your resume as a file of not more than 100 KB.
Give a valid personal e-mail address. ICSI will contact candidates by e-mail, not by post.
Print the submitted form and keep it for reference. ICSI does not send a separate acknowledgement.

Do not post a hard copy of the form, your CV or certificates to the Institute. Bring the original documents when you are called for verification. Incomplete, vague or wrongly formatted applications will be rejected. Candidature can be cancelled at any stage, and the contract terminated, if false information is found. Canvassing in any form leads to disqualification. Any dispute falls under the courts in New Delhi.

content_sections.heading: ICSI Assistant Young Professional Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Age limit: Maximum 32 years as on 01.11.2026. Qualification: Must have passed the Executive level Examination of the ICSI. Experience: Candidates with post-qualification experience of up to one year will be considered. Training experience that forms part of the CS course curriculum is not counted towards experience. Cut-off date: 01.11.2026 is the cut-off date for all purposes, including age, qualifications and experience. Character: Candidates must have good moral character, with no criminal antecedents or FIR against them. Candidates should check the full eligibility conditions in the official notification before applying.

content_sections.heading: Job Description
content_sections.text: Assistant Young Professionals will examine and process e-forms under the Companies Act 2013 and the LLP Act 2008, read with the relevant rules, according to the roles assigned to them in the CRC, C-PACE, CSC and CPC offices. Each professional must clear the minimum number of forms or targets set by the Central Facility Centres. Productivity beyond the benchmark carries significant weight in performance appraisals.

rows.event: Cut-off date for age, qualification and experience

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The Selection Committee screens the applications. Shortlisted candidates are informed about the final selection process by e-mail. Original documents are verified at a later stage. Selected candidates undergo an orientation programme to learn the functions of the Central Facility Centres. No TA/DA is paid for attending the selection process, for joining or on completing the assignment.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The contract is initially for one year. It may be extended every year for up to two more years, based on performance and requirement, or until the candidate turns 35, whichever is earlier. Performance is reviewed at the end of each year. Work runs from Monday to Saturday, 48 hours a week, which may depend on achieving targets. Engagement is on a full working day basis. Place of work: Central Facility Centres (CRC/C-PACE/CSC/CPC), IICA, Plot No. 6,7,8, Sec-5, IMT Manesar, near Gurugram (Haryana)-122050. The contract is purely temporary (non-official), and ICSI can end it at any time without giving reasons. AYPs have no right to claim engagement or employment in the Government of India or ICSI.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ICSI Assistant Young Professional Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Open the ICSI online recruitment portal between 06.11.2026 and 20.11.2026. Use Windows Explorer (6.x to 11.x) or Google Chrome with JavaScript enabled. The notice says not to use Mozilla Firefox, Netscape Navigator or any other browser. Fill in every field of the online Resume Form. Do not use special characters such as quotation marks or &. Keep entries short for university name, specialisation, responsibilities, address and school name. Enter percentages rounded down to the whole number (49.3% or 49.8% becomes 49%). Convert grades into equivalent percentages. Upload your resume as a file of not more than 100 KB. Give a valid personal e-mail address. ICSI will contact candidates by e-mail, not by post. Print the submitted form and keep it for reference. ICSI does not send a separate acknowledgement. Do not post a hard copy of the form, your CV or certificates to the Institute. Bring the original documents when you are called for verification. Incomplete, vague or wrongly formatted applications will be rejected. Candidature can be cancelled at any stage, and the contract terminated, if false information is found. Canvassing in any form leads to disqualification. Any dispute falls under the courts in New Delhi.

faq.question: Q1. How many Assistant Young Professional posts has ICSI advertised?
faq.answer: ICSI has advertised 08 posts for the Central Facility Centres at IMT Manesar.

faq.question: Q2. Can CS Executive passed candidates apply?
faq.answer: Yes. The post is meant for semi-qualified persons who have passed the Executive level Examination of the ICSI.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age for this post?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 32 years as on 01.11.2026. The same date is the cut-off for qualification and experience.

faq.question: Q4. Does my CS training count as experience?
faq.answer: No. Training that forms part of the CS course curriculum is not counted. Post-qualification experience of up to one year is considered.

faq.question: Q5. How much will an Assistant Young Professional earn?
faq.answer: The consolidated pay is Rs. 40000 a month in the first year, Rs. 42500 in the second and Rs. 45000 in the third. Duty on Sundays and holidays earns an extra Rs. 2500 per day.

faq.question: Q6. How long is the contract?
faq.answer: The contract is initially for one year. It can be extended yearly for up to two more years, or until the age of 35, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q7. What are the working hours?
faq.answer: The work week runs from Monday to Saturday, 48 hours in total, and may depend on achieving targets.

faq.question: Q8. Do I need to send a printed application to ICSI?
faq.answer: No. Apply online only and keep a printout for yourself. Do not send the form, CV or certificates by post.

faq.question: Q9. What file size is allowed for the resume?
faq.answer: The resume file you upload must not exceed 100 KB.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I send questions about this recruitment?
faq.answer: Questions can be e-mailed to the Directorate of HR, ICSI, at [email protected].
